title: Bitrig Can Build HomeView Apps and Widgets
summary: HomeView runs audio and video CarPlay apps and Widgets from your iPhone.
body_markdown:
Our HomeView for Bitrig HQ arrived today. It’s a charming little device. Of course, we immediately got to work getting our apps running on it.


Good news:


**If you want to build an app for HomeView, Bitrig already supports everything you need.**


There’s no HomeView SDK, but HomeView can run audio and video[CarPlay apps](https://bitrig.com/blog/bitrig-builds-carplay-apps) and[Widgets](https://bitrig.com/blog/bitrig-builds-widgets) from your phone.


So if you’ve got an idea that’ll make HomeView an even better hub for you and your household, rest assured you can build it with Bitrig.
